instructions: Hold your booking QR or your flash booking QR up to the camera

signIn.title: QR reader
signIn.help: Paste the reader key. The council administration creates it on the facility page, under “Entrance QR readers”.
signIn.rejected: That key is not valid or the reader was removed.

camera.denied: The camera is needed. Allow access in the browser and try again.
camera.missing: No camera found on this device.
camera.insecure: The camera only works when the page is served over https.
camera.failed: The camera could not be started.

offline.title: No connection
offline.detail: The booking could not be checked. Try again in a moment.

result.tooEarlyDetail: Your turn is {{day}} at {{start}}. You can come in from {{from}}.
result.otherFacility: This booking is for another facility
result.unknownDetail: Check that it is the QR of a current booking.
result.notABooking: This QR is not a booking
result.notABookingDetail: Show the entry QR from “Your bookings”.
result.codeExpiredDetail: Show the current code from “Flash booking”: it changes every minute.
result.readerOffDetail: The council has turned this facility’s reader off. Go in another way or ask the staff.

reason.no_turn_soon: No turn is under way or starts in the next 15 minutes.
reason.slot_closed: The facility is closed during this turn.
reason.slot_too_far: The next turn cannot be booked yet.
reason.profile_incomplete: Add your date of birth to your profile to book.
reason.age_restricted: You do not meet the minimum age for this facility.
reason.booking_limit_reached: You have reached the limit of bookings at this facility.
reason.booking_overlaps: You already have another booking at that time.
reason.facility_not_found: This facility cannot be booked right now.
reason.other: Book in the app, or ask the staff.
reason.use_booking_qr: You have a booking here: go in with that booking's QR.
reason.flash_off: The council does not let a free turn be booked at the door here. Book in the app.
